# Blender-derived icon notice

The following Nanquim assets contain Blender UI icon artwork:

- `public/assets/img/blender_icons.svg`
- `public/assets/img/nanquim-logo.svg`
- `public/assets/img/icons/properties-element.svg`

The retained sheet identifies itself as a Blender 2.81 icon document. The
original Blender icon system is credited to Andrzej Ambroż (`jendrzych`) and
contains later contributions by Blender Authors. Nanquim's two smaller files
extract and adapt paths from that sheet. The pen-nib used as Nanquim's mark is
not Blender's protected product logo.

Blender states that individual UI icons are GPL material:

- <https://www.blender.org/support/faq/>
- <https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender>

The local sheet does not contain an upstream commit identifier or complete
license header, and Nanquim's Git history does not record its original download
URL. Its exact byte-level upstream revision therefore remains unresolved.
Nanquim redistributes the sheet and its local derivatives under GNU GPL v3;
the full applicable text is in the repository root `LICENSE` file.

Do not replace this sheet from a current Blender checkout without checking icon
coordinates, provenance, license notices, and every Nanquim sprite reference.
